API Reference › Biosignal Library

labkit.biosignal.compareGroups

Summarize groups and compute pairwise Welch comparisons.

Syntax

result = labkit.biosignal.compareGroups(values, groups);

Inputs

values
numeric vector of measurements.
groups
string/cellstr/categorical-compatible vector of group labels.

Output

result
struct with summary table and pairwise Welch-comparison table. Missing values and blank group labels are ignored.
